jd:
WE ARE HIRING | 5 SOFTWARE ENGINEERING INTERNS | SAN FRANSCISCO BAY AREA


Making Construction Possible – The Future of Construction Is Open.


Build Your Career. Gain International Experience. Grow With JERRNI.JERRNI is a sustainable, modular homebuilding company headquartered in Palo Alto, California.


Why should advanced construction technology be accessible only to organizations that can afford expensive software licenses?


We are embarking on an ambitious journey to democratize the global construction industry by developing a comprehensive, AI-native, open-source construction software ecosystem.
Our mission is to bring together artificial intelligence, construction ERP, BIM, digital twins, data science, machine learning, Web3 and emerging technologies into one interconnected, accessible ecosystem.
We are inviting five talented and ambitious software engineering interns to become part of our founding development team.


Available opportunities:
🔹 Full-Stack Software Engineering & Construction ERP
🔹 Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
🔹 BIM, Digital Twins & 3D Technologies
🔹 Data Engineering & Backend Development
🔹 Cloud, DevOps, Web3 & Emerging Technologies


Internship Details:
🌍 Location: SAN FRANSCISCO BAY AREA – Remote
📅 Duration: 6 months
👥 Initial intake: 5 interns, with potential future intakes
💰 Paid internship
📈 Potential long-term employment opportunities


We welcome students, recent graduates and self-taught developers who are passionate about innovation, artificial intelligence and open-source development.
We are looking for curious minds, creative thinkers, problem-solvers and individuals who are not afraid to challenge conventional technology.


We are not simply building another software application. We are building an ecosystem that aims to redefine how the world plans, designs, builds, operates and manages construction projects.


Open source. Open innovation. Unlimited possibilities.
If you believe technology should empower everyone, we invite you to be part of this journey.
Apply through our LinkedIn job posting.
Please share this opportunity with aspiring developers, engineering students and technology enthusiasts across USA.


At JERRNI, we believe addressing the global housing challenge requires a people-centred approach alongside innovation in construction.


Together, let's Make Construction Possible.


Email: si@jerrni.com
